notes.title: Multiplayer & New Leaderboard Update
notes.content:
The Rapid Tap Multiplayer update is now live on both Steam and Android! iOS coming this week. Update removes ads from mobile, adds multiplayer, fixes many bugs, and adds a new leaderboard to the game! Play now to see who can get the most clicks and grab that new #1 rank.

The old Rapid Tap leaderboard was based on a bad scoring system I came up with during the initial 12 hour livestream when I made the prototype of the game. It was easy for good players to get too high of a score and then it'd turn negative. Now it's just click count.

There's a few bugs in Rapid Tap that still gotta get ironed out, especially for mobile. As always, please send me any bugs, suggestions, or comments. I really do appreciate them and all of you. You guys help me learn a ton and I love you all for that.

Twitter: https://twitter.com/Wolfborg13
Twitch: https://www.twitch.tv/wolfborgg
